newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, mainly on stronger future.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, mainly on stronger future.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline was up as NYMEX unleaded gains broke Wednesday's stalemate. Eurograde traded at $210 fob Rott.
Naphtha was slightly stronger in line with crude gains.
Gas oil climbed in line with $2.00 gains on the IPE screen, but heating oil barges started to ease in response to scant buying interest from German end-users.
High sulphur fuel barges gained $1-$2 as stronger bunker demand helped trade. Low sulphur swaps eased fractionally and a cargo passed from trader to trader at floating price.
